scripts.build: bun run build:relay && bun run build:agent
scripts.test: bun run test:relay && bun run test:agent
scripts.lint: bun run lint:relay && bun run lint:agent
scripts.clean: bun run --cwd apps/relay clean && rm -rf packages/shared/dist packages/shared/*.tsbuildinfo apps/relay/*.tsbuildinfo apps/relay/.wrangler apps/agent/swift/.build apps/agent/native/sentinel-app/.build
scripts.protocol:generate: bun run --cwd packages/shared build && node tools/generate-command-contract.mjs
